units.source_text: 在这场争吵当中，我始终懊恼的痛哭流涕。

en.t: During this quarrel, I kept crying bitterly in frustration.

units.source_text: 等到父亲送走丸佐的老板，拿着无尽灯从店里回到仓库的时候，

en.t: When Father had seen off the owner of Marusa and came back from the shop to the storehouse carrying the Mujinto lamp,

units.source_text: 不，不仅仅是我，就连哥哥也在看到父亲的神色后，突然闭嘴不言。

en.t: No, not only I, but even my brother suddenly fell silent when he saw Father's expression.

units.source_text: 对我来说，沉默的父亲比当时凶狠的哥哥更加的可怕。

en.t: To me, my silent father was far more frightening than my brother had been in his fierceness then.
